mobile.name: skeleton warrior dungeon
mobile.long_descr: The bones of a long-dead warrior rattle as it lurches toward you.
mobile.description: Empty eye sockets glow with a sickly green light. Rusted armour still clings to its yellowed bones.

mobile.name: necromancer crypt dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A gaunt figure in tattered robes weaves dark energies around itself.
mobile.description: Its flesh is pale as chalk and its fingers are stained black with necrotic magic.

mobile.name: goblin cave dungeon raider
mobile.long_descr: A vicious goblin lurks in the shadows, clutching a crude blade.
mobile.description: Small but ferocious, this goblin's hide is scarred from countless brawls.

mobile.name: cave troll dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A massive cave troll blocks the passage, its knuckles dragging the ground.
mobile.description: Its grey skin is thick as stone and its beady eyes gleam with dull malice.

mobile.name: revenant ruins dungeon
mobile.long_descr: A revenant drifts through the crumbling halls, hunger in its hollow gaze.
mobile.description: An echo of a mortal who refused to pass on, it radiates dread and cold.

mobile.name: specter ruins dungeon phantom
mobile.long_descr: A translucent form drifts through the ruined walls, wailing softly.
mobile.description: Almost invisible, the specter occasionally sharpens into a horrifying face before fading again.
